title: Mixed7 Duo #13 (임산부+바디페인팅)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each from a different Living Artifact track.

#1 (Pregnant track): Korean, in her mid 20s, demure and soft expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy, her upper body so wide. A mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her upper silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders — and below it, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward just as prominently, the bust and the belly together forming the two dominant curves of her frame. Round hips and soft thighs continue below. Her head looks small between her massive bust and belly. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, flawless porcelain skin, soft rose-pink lips, delicate graceful eye makeup, twin-tail hair, real pores, 8 drop dangles piercings with diamonds in mixed-toned metal, wearing four to six pieces of silver a hair ornament. Painted in Spanish Andalusian filigree, a deep black ground with fine silver filigree in geometric star patterns, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle, wide silver bands curving fully around her belly, the densest concentration of geometric star filigree wrapping the belly as centrepiece and continuing over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, extreme silver extreme platform high heels.

#2 (Bodypaint track): a real adult Vietnamese woman in her early 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, soft porcelain skin, delicate rose-pink eyeshadow, glossy soft-coral lips, bold and confident, braided hair, real living eyes. Long square nails, holographic finish. an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, projecting forward past the line of her own knees, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Painted in Croatian Hvar filigree-inspired linework (an ivory ground with fine cream and gold painted filigree linework), wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense fine filigree linework filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted. Pose: leaning against a wall just out of frame. Footwear: extreme gold extreme platform lace-up sandals.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all bodypaint/pregnant/irezumi/stained-glass/gold-leaf/botanical women from one side, realistic photographic grain where applicable, extreme high-gloss oil on maximalist tracks — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render; any UV Neon track woman additionally lit by her own dedicated UV blacklight spot. Pattern density maximum on all 2, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio.
